records.reasoning: The user already has a question catalog and specifically requested editing suggestions. Generated quantity is not usefulness.
records.advantages: Avoids duplicate work and an overwhelming review backlog; retains instructor/user/AI provenance.
records.costs_or_drawbacks: Requires selection and deduplication; fewer automatic cards may look less impressive initially.
records.alternative_and_when: Allow batch approval later for trustworthy question families, with explicit load limits and preserved item/version history.
records.evidence_to_resolve: Actual saved question formats, answer/rubric quality, preferred question types, maximum comfortable review load and delete-versus-archive semantics.

records.question: Should review live in this app, export to Anki, or synchronize both directions?
records.recommendation: Build only an approved operational review queue referencing canonical question/attempt identities; no separate performance authority.
records.reasoning: Native teach-back/source context and remediation are the core interaction. Two independent schedulers can create conflicting histories and more integration work.
records.advantages: One coherent attempt/exposure record and less synchronization complexity.
records.costs_or_drawbacks: Existing Anki habits are not automatically preserved; running both queues can duplicate reviews unless the user chooses one scheduler owner.
records.alternative_and_when: If an active Anki workflow is essential, make Anki the scheduler authority and design that integration explicitly before building another queue.
records.evidence_to_resolve: Current actual Anki use and export needs, scheduler ownership, response-to-rating rules, card revision/review reset semantics and reminder preference.
records.prior_recommendation: Pilot an in-app source-linked review queue with an established scheduler, separate from diagnostic tutoring. Preserve item IDs for later export; add one-way Anki export before considering two-way schedule/history sync.
records.remaining_status: Design recommendation only; no new user execution/write/runtime permission inferred.

records.question: What should the slide-level understanding indicator mean to you?
records.recommendation: Derive gap views from effective canonical assessment evidence and narrow diagnostic events; preserve assistance, recency and unobserved states.
records.reasoning: The report explicitly calls saved counts observations rather than mastery percentages, and zero attempts is not zero competence.
records.advantages: Honest, actionable feedback that preserves unknowns and the difference between independent and assisted work.
records.costs_or_drawbacks: Less visually simple than one score; users need a compact default view with drill-down evidence.
records.alternative_and_when: A score can display a defined observed denominator (for example sampled rubric criteria), not an unsupported total-knowledge probability.
records.evidence_to_resolve: Preferred summary wording, evidence drill-down, time/assistance display and whether any numeric rubric result is useful.
records.prior_recommendation: Show supporting evidence and conditions across recall, explanation and application; use not assessed, supported with help, independently demonstrated on sampled tasks and needs a fresh check. Avoid an uncalibrated mastery percentage.
records.remaining_status: Further evidence/approval where indicated; reported existing behavior is not an executed new-app gate.

records.question: How should exam relevance, foundational importance and your immediate study priority affect ordering?
records.recommendation: Keep assessment relevance, foundation and personal priority distinct; qualitative source-backed reasons, no unsupported exam probability.
records.reasoning: The notes ask for both importance and understanding. Conflating them can hide needed prerequisites or overstate assessment predictions.
records.advantages: Prioritizes work without pretending the tutor knows the exam; can use instructor signals with clear provenance.
records.costs_or_drawbacks: Less magical than a predicted exam likelihood; objectives and assessment guidance may be incomplete.
records.alternative_and_when: Allow explicit exam-preparation mode with source-backed prioritization while retaining foundations and non-exam goals.
records.evidence_to_resolve: Syllabus/objectives/instructor guidance/permitted past assessments plus user preference on depth versus upcoming-assessment emphasis.
records.prior_recommendation: Keep three separate signals: documented assessment relevance, justified prerequisite/foundational role, and personal priority based on current goals/evidence. Explain each reason; allow manual overrides. No numeric exam probability without an appropriate evidence/model basis.
records.remaining_status: Further evidence/approval where indicated; reported existing behavior is not an executed new-app gate.

records.recommendation: Design source-first responsive views across approved devices; prototype embedded versus standalone presentation without silently replacing the requested experience.
records.reasoning: Beauty is requested, but the draft has no approved visual prototype, responsive layout or tested figure/math interaction. Do not let a graph or status dashboard displace studying.
records.advantages: Coherent navigation and reusable components; fewer competing panels and easier keyboard access.
records.costs_or_drawbacks: There are trade-offs between transcript, source, chat and recording space; mobile needs a different arrangement and may be deferred by explicit choice.

records.evidence_to_resolve: Typical screen size and two or three reference interfaces; observed ability to play a clip, ask, inspect a source and return without losing work.

records.question: What should happen on duplicate sends, provider changes, permission prompts, cancellation, sleep or an unknown completion?
records.recommendation: Local supervisor remains design. Prepare safe proof; on uncertain outcome stop and reconcile instead of resend/reconfigure.
records.reasoning: v0.2.0 already proposes these semantics. They are not yet implemented or tested, and completion receipt is different from accepted output.
records.advantages: Avoids duplicate learning evidence, lost questions, cross-course context and late-answer overwrites.
records.costs_or_drawbacks: More explicit operational states; uncertain jobs may require reconciliation rather than an invisible retry. At-most-one accepted publication does not guarantee one inference computation.
records.alternative_and_when: Persistent background processing can be approved later. Never infer permission for hidden startup tasks, automatic spending or desktop click automation.
records.evidence_to_resolve: Expected closed-app behavior, user-approved notifications, retry/cancel decisions and actual crash/duplicate/native-disconnection tests.
records.prior_recommendation: Use immutable per-request bundles and a single coordinator; separate response display from canonical assessment save. Serialize within a thread, keep exact session IDs and require deliberate retry/provider transfer. Browsing and drafts stay available while AI is blocked.
records.remaining_status: Design recommendation only; no new user execution/write/runtime permission inferred.

records.question: How much conversation and raw voice history should be retained, who may access it, and what can be deleted or exported?

records.reasoning: Existing canonical attempts preserve provenance; local app, provider history, backups and Drive copies are different retention surfaces. Deletion of one cannot be advertised as deletion everywhere.
records.advantages: Reduces unnecessary sensitive data accumulation and gives control without destroying original sources silently.
records.costs_or_drawbacks: Some diagnosis/reproducibility context disappears when raw audio is deleted; comprehensive deletion must reconcile history, derived indices and backups.

records.question: Which technical architecture and maintained components should we use, and what needs ongoing ownership?
records.recommendation: One modular local supervisor with native/Drive/sidecar/writer wrappers and generated views over existing records.
records.reasoning: The hard choices are source/record/provider contracts. Choosing many services before those are known increases coordination and may duplicate existing scripts.
records.advantages: Smaller code and installation surface, easier end-to-end testing and clear reuse opportunities.
records.costs_or_drawbacks: Not an internet-scale deployment; native/provider changes still require compatibility checks. A maintainer must own upgrades, backups and broken adapters.
records.alternative_and_when: A hosted reader and existing Windows writer is a conservative conditional proposal; full laptop-off canonical saves need an approved always-on owner. User decides the availability compromise.
records.evidence_to_resolve: Actual existing runtime/scripts, source formats and scale; audited candidate licenses/interfaces; named maintainer and supported OS/provider version matrix.
records.prior_recommendation: Start with one modular local application/companion, a bounded job journal and one authority per data type. Use established viewer, transcription, scheduling and protocol components after sample/version checks; keep provider adapters thin and explicit. Do not require a graph database, agent fleet or universal framework in the pilot.
